note: Item codes are the .sav column names, unchanged by data/ecuador_2011_safety.do (Table 9 surroundings, local survey_cols I51901-I51906). The .sav variable labels tie each code to the form's q.5.19 sub-option by number and content, 6/6: I51901 = "I51901. Conoce .si en los alrededores  existen.pandillas...", I51902 = "I51902.  Jorgas o grupos de amigos", I51903 = "I51903 . Vendedores de drogas..", I51904 = "I51904. Trabajadoras sexuales", I51905 = "I51905. Bares o cantinas", I51906 = "I51906. Otros......."; form sub-options are numbered 1-6 in the same order. Words are the official Spanish questionnaire p.8 (section V. PERCEPCION DE LA INSEGURIDAD PUBLICA, q.5.19), checked against the rendered page image, not the terse .sav labels (e.g. the .sav says Vendedores de drogas where the form prints Vendedores y consumidores de drogas?). The question stem is shared by all six sub-options and goes in instructions, de-hyphenated from the form's line breaks (escu-chado, alrededo-res, exis-ten) with the form's closing ellipsis; the interviewer line ANOTE EL CODIGO CORRESPONDIENTE PARA CADA OPCION (RM) is not shipped. item_text is each sub-option as printed (lower-case initials and no space before ? as on the form). I51906 is the form's catch-all Otros? with a write-in line labelled Especifique; shipped as Otros? Especifique; the write-in content is not in the IRW table. Options: form prints Si 1 / No 2 / No sabe 8 / No responde 9 (Si without accent, as printed); .sav value labels identical. The do-file maps Si->1, No->0 and drops 8/9, so IRW resp 1 = Si, 0 = No. Route 9 by server-side GROUP BY (no export): live item x resp counts equal .sav counts in 12/12 cells (resp 0/1: I51901 71965/43184; I51902 53645/62688; I51903 67053/45445; I51904 97668/17141; I51905 73674/43115; I51906 109988/2896). Dropped No sabe/No responde per item: I51901 2495/93, I51902 1312/92, I51903 5122/117, I51904 2811/117, I51905 836/112, I51906 1060/3793, so per-item n is uneven (112,498-116,789). Live: 688,462 rows, 117,584 ids (of 117,737 .sav informants), 0 duplicate id-item. English _translated columns are machine translation by this project; Jorgas (Ecuadorian colloquial term for a group of youths/friends) is kept untranslated in the English, as the form glosses it itself.
